# DigiAds.click

> DigiAds.click is a digital growth service from AO Plus Solutions Pvt Ltd. It builds a brand foundation, sets up a digital presence and runs lead-generation campaigns, with a checkpoint at every step so clients can see what is working. It also offers one-time audits of a website, AI visibility and social media profiles.

No lead numbers are guaranteed. Results depend on the market, the offer, the ad budget and how quickly the client follows up. Advertising spend (for example Meta ads) is paid by the client directly to the ad platform.

## Programs and plans
- [90-Day Growth Program](https://digiads.click/program): fixed scope and price for 90 days, INR 90,000 excluding GST. Brand foundation, digital presence, lead generation and optimization, with a written growth plan before payment.
- [Monthly plans](https://digiads.click/#pricing): Starter INR 15,000, Growth INR 35,000, Scale from INR 75,000, per month, excluding GST. An AI visibility add-on is INR 9,999 per month, excluding GST.
- International visitors see purchasing-power-adjusted USD prices on the site; Indian prices are in INR plus 18% GST.

## Audits (one-time, excluding GST)
- AI visibility report, INR 399: how ready a website is to be found and cited by AI assistants.
- Website audit, INR 499: SEO, speed, security and conversion checks.
- Full audit with roadmap, INR 2,499: website and AI visibility audits, a 90-day action plan and a walkthrough call.
- Social media audit, INR 3,999: profile, bio and content review for one account.
- [Free AI visibility report](https://kya.digiads.click): a free report on how ready a site is for AI assistants. Contact details are asked only so the team can follow up, and only with consent.
